## Appearance

As a young child, she is small, thin, freckled, and pale, with a pointed chin, big gray eyes, and thick, bright red hair usually worn in braids. Over time, her hair darkens to an auburn color and is cut short into curls after a hair-dye mishap before growing back. By age sixteen, she has grown tall and slim, with a proudly poised head, clear skin, and a stylish, expressive presence.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P37](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0037), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c28 P6](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0006), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v1 c31 P16](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0016), [v1 c33 P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013)_

## Personality

Anne is intensely imaginative, romantic, and talkative, frequently inventing names for nature and falling into vivid daydreams. She possesses a fiery temper when provoked, especially regarding her red hair, but is quick to feel remorse and apologize deeply. She is fiercely loyal, passionate in her friendships, and possesses a strong capacity for love and gratitude. Highly ambitious and hardworking, she strives for excellence in her academic pursuits while maintaining a deeply sensitive and optimistic outlook on life.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P24](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0024), [v1 c2 P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P16](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0016), [v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037), [v1 c15 P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c34 P27](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0027), [v1 c38 P25](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0025)_

## History

Anne Shirley is mistakenly sent to Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Green Gables, who had intended to adopt a boy to help on the farm. Though Marilla initially plans to send her back, she and Matthew decide to keep her. Anne settles into Avonlea, forming an intense 'bosom' friendship with Diana Barry and entering school, where she breaks a slate over Gilbert Blythe's head after he calls her 'Carrots', sparking a lifelong academic rivalry. Over the years, Anne experiences various misadventures, such as unintentionally getting Diana drunk on currant wine, accidentally dyeing her hair green, and falling off a roof while walking a ridgepole on a dare. She forms a story club, participates in school concerts, and joins Miss Stacy's Queen's prep class. Upon entering Queen's Academy, she wins the prestigious Avery Scholarship. However, after Matthew suddenly dies of a heart attack and Marilla faces failing eyesight, Anne gives up her scholarship to stay at Green Gables, teach at Avonlea school, and care for Marilla, finally reconciling and making peace with Gilbert Blythe.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c16 P48](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0048), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P33](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0033), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v1 c38 P54](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0054), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia to high school teachers Walter and Bertha Shirley, who both died of fever when she was three months old  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised by Mrs. Thomas until age eight, helping look after four younger children  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived with Mrs. Hammond for over two years, looking after eight children including three sets of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Spent four months in an orphan asylum at Hopeton before being brought to Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
